title: Frontend: User profile
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind User profile. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({profile}). Missing profile renders Profile unavailable. Otherwise render name as h1, bio in [data-testid="bio"] default No biography, and either img with alt=name or [data-testid="avatar-fallback"] containing uppercase first name character. Do not fetch remotely.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Accept a profile object rather than mixing fetch logic into a presentational card.
alternativeApproaches: Separate public profile fields from account-private details using a server-defined response contract.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Missing avatar; empty bio; long name.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
